name: subnet
title: Private subnet
description: Yuma consensus with sealed (commit-reveal) weights: validators can't copy each other, outliers get clipped to the stake-weighted median.

everyone_sees: who the validators and miners are and their stake
that a validator committed (the seal), and the weights once revealed
kept_secret: each validator's weights until the reveal phase, so nobody can copy them
privacy.summary: Keeps weights sealed until everyone has committed; after the reveal they are public.
